Show Loves Only You (School Uniform / Winter)
「You're a promising prospect for the Twinkle Series!」
Huh...?
Huh...? Trainer-san?

That's why winning far away from everyone—
wouldn't let me give back "love." Nor could I receive everyone's "love."
「We'll cheer you on even more from now on!」

「But nothing we say is gonna change her mind now.
Damn it... are we really just gonna sit here and watch her struggle...?!」
「You're... affiliated with Tracen Academy...?!」
「We've watched you run every single day!」

Thank you...! 
Seeing everyone so happy makes me happy too!

Not at all. In fact, it's pretty close to the mark.
Let's use this as a baseline and find areas to improve.

Which only makes me feel like the burden is far too heavy for me.
My heart tries to stop me, asking who am I to shoulder such a weight. But—

And based on the information gathered there...
I must absorb knowledge from every angle to make up for my shortcomings.
「I'll... help out through manga.」

「A racing report series, that is.
So I won't be able to help until after her debut, but...」
I don't want... distant applause.

I see... I have given my advice as an educator.
Think it over carefully. ...Just ensure you have no regrets.

「I guess I can help out a tiiiny bit with overseas press stuff~.
I am an aspiring sports journalist, after all. Even if it's just a minor magazine.」
「...But hey, can someone who chickened out and couldn't take the leap until now really save that girl? Especially a rookie like you?」
「Connect to the future, you say... but as outsiders, there's nothing we—」

「I work as an assistant at a virtual talent agency, you know!
I'll pull useful tips and broadcast Loves-chan's charm to the world!」

Because everyone was there, because it made you all happy...
running became so much more fun, and that's why I entered Tracen Academy.
「So you'll be fine! You can definitely win!」

Tomorrow's meet includes kids from the junior race club!
I'm participating too... but I wonder if I can run well?

「...Then next time, talk to all of us sooner.
We're comrades wishing for her happiness, aren't we?」

If you cannot debut, you cannot even stand at the starting line. Hone yourself
in a stoic environment. By doing so and seizing victory, you can repay your fans.
The resolve is already right here in my chest.

I pull out my Trainer license, take a picture
with my camera, and post it to the chat.
"Wait, "The Bridge"... is a Trainer...?"

I'll handle the checkout procedure, so please step this way.
I hope this helps everyone enjoy their racing careers injury-free.

"It's not just 'workout guy', you know. To some extent or
another, none of us really understood how she felt either."
...Yeah!
"Congratulations! That was an incredible run!"

To guide her properly as a Trainer, I need to perfectly grasp
her strengths and weaknesses in distance, track condition, and pacing just by watching her run.

...Um, I'm sorry.
This doesn't have anything to do with you, Trainer, and yet—
I see... So you're the one who advised her on this form.

Heh, those don't look like the eyes of a rookie. You look like a real pro.
Seems you're truly serious about mastering Tracen Academy's cutting-edge nutritional science.

Sports medicine... I see.
However, there's quite a lot of material here to comprehend in just a single reading.

Everyone who loves her needs to stay by her side,
now and forever.
—Everyone has always been by my side.

It might not be a grand mission or some lofty ideal.
Yet everyone here saw hope in the future they would walk together with her.

"You idiot! Then why didn't you scout Loves-chan
first thing?! And you call yourself a fan?!"

"If you truly care about her,
you can't even think about backing out!"
"Whaaaaaaaaat?!"

"You said you'd connect her to the future.
You'd better bridge that gap no matter what, 'The Bridge'... No, our Trainer!"

"...To be honest, I want to watch too, if possible.
Her talking happily about her training and daily life, that is."

"Exactly! You're the only one who can support her running with everything you've got.
In return, we'll support her as a streamer!"

Starting tomorrow, I'll be doing my best at Tracen Academy~♪
It's a day early, but I wanted to show off my uniform on stream!♡

She is a talented Umamusume. Winning a GⅠ is certainly no mere dream.
Those legs hold the potential to seize a brilliant future.

I heard the news. Looks like you still haven't found a Trainer.
What a waste of such remarkable talent... A real shame.

—Observing? 
I don't mind, but...?

That Trainer...
Did something about their vibe change...?
"...Did I end up backing her into a corner?"

Oh my? Are you still here?
The school building will be locked down for the night soon, you know.
